subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 1 – Lesson 3: Vocabulary and Grammar (Outdoor toys)
outcomes: I can name six outdoor toys.
I can ask: Is it a swing? and answer: Yes, it is. / No, it isn't.

tf.s: A kite flies in the sky.
tf.why: Yes! A kite flies up high.

tf.s: A slide is an indoor toy.
tf.why: A slide is an outdoor toy.

tf.s: Is it a ball? (a ball) Yes, it is.
tf.why: Yes! It is a ball, so we say Yes, it is.

tf.s: Is it a scooter? (a bike) Yes, it is.
tf.why: It's a bike, so we say No, it isn't.

tf.s: No, it isn't. means it is not the right toy.
tf.why: Well done! isn't means is not.

tf.s: Yes, it is. is the answer when the toy is wrong.
tf.why: When it is wrong we say No, it isn't.

tf.s: Kite, bike and swing are outdoor toys.
tf.why: Yes! We play with them outside.
A swing is an outdoor toy.

tf.s: We ask Is it a ...? to tell our age.
tf.why: Is it a ...? is a guessing question about a thing.

boxes.q: Which toy flies in the sky?
boxes.why: A kite flies in the sky.

boxes.q: We go down it in the park.

boxes.why: It's a slide, so the answer is No.
It is a kite, so we say Yes.

boxes.q: We go back and forth on a...
boxes.why: A swing goes back and forth.
Is it a bike? asks about a toy.

boxes.q: Which toy has two wheels and pedals?
boxes.why: A bike has wheels and pedals.

hunt.q: You sit and go back and forth.
You stand on it and push.

mcq.q: How many outdoor toys do we learn?
mcq.why: Kite, bike, slide, scooter, ball and swing: six toys.

mcq.q: Which one is an outdoor toy?
mcq.why: A swing is outside in the park.

mcq.q: What is the short way to say is not?

mcq.why: Yes, it is. says it is right.

mcq.q: Your friend mimes riding a bike. You ask...
mcq.why: We ask Is it a ...? to guess.

mcq.q: Teacher shows a bike: Is it a scooter? You say...
mcq.why: It's a bike, not a scooter.

mcq.q: You see a kite. Teacher: What's this? You say...
Clues: It's outdoor. You ride it. It's not a scooter. What is it?
mcq.why: We ride a bike. It is not a scooter.

mcq.q: Which is the odd one out?
mcq.why: A teddy is an indoor toy. The others are outdoor toys.

mcq.q: Is it a ball? The answer is No, it isn't. What can the picture be?
mcq.why: No means it is not a ball, so it is a kite.
